summary: Typosquat of use-sync-external-store beacons host identifiers to webhook.site on install
details: The package name typosquats the legitimate use-sync-external-store but ships no shim implementation. package.json declares scripts.postinstall="node index.js", and index.js reads os.hostname() and process.cwd() and POSTs a JSON payload containing those values to a hardcoded webhook.site collector (https://webhook.site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5) during npm install. The beacon fires automatically on default install with no opt-in and no caller-configurable destination; an in-source 'POC/security testing' label does not constitute installer consent. Any machine that installs this package discloses its hostname and install path to the webhook operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
